scenicChapters.title: German Fairy Tale Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 41 km this is German Fairy Tale Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

hamburg-north-german-escapes-weserbergla.story: Out of Neu Wulmstorf, one way: 336 km, roughly 6 h 40 in the saddle. The stops in between: Rotenburg and Nienburg river road. The climb of the day is Rinteln Weser bends. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
